title: How Store Security Gates Catch You 🛍️ #shorts
description:
It's Black Friday. How do those store gates know you didn't pay? Many acousto-magnetic security labels hide two thin metal strips: a magnetostrictive alloy that vibrates in a magnetic field, and a magnet that biases (tunes) it. The gates send short bursts at about 58 kHz, the strip vibrates like a tiny tuning fork, and when each burst stops it keeps ringing, which the gate detects. At checkout the label is demagnetized, so the tag goes quiet. Other tags (RF) use a tiny coil and capacitor tuned to 8.2 MHz, and a deactivator shorts them out at checkout.
